headline: vVardis Targets IPO at Up to $24 Per Share
summary: Dental healthcare company vVardis has set its initial public offering target at up to $24 per share.
why: IPO pricing announcements signal private-to-public equity valuations and provide new capital for commercial expansion in the healthcare sector.

impacts.name: vVardis
impacts.why: Launching an IPO raises public capital for corporate growth.
